split_source: Official all/train.txt + all/dev.txt for training; official all/test.txt untouched
initialization: fresh random seed43; no previously trained weights
temporal_alignment: AVI frame i at i/20 seconds; linear RGB interpolation to n/30; pulse interpolated using stored HDF5 time; initial BVP endpoint hold 1/256 s
cache: lossless native-time post-legacy-crop/float-resize float32 NPY; no quantization
crop: unchanged legacy first-frame HC1.5 square/center fallback; torchvision ToTensor + bilinear antialias128
coverage: all complete160-frame derivative chunks with one real support frame; no artificial temporal extension
input_normalization: unchanged per-clip temporal difference divided by sum and sample standard deviation
train_hr_target: unchanged official derivative-Welch; explicit min40/max180; no clamp or clip exclusion
scorer: pinned FFT+cumsum+sparse detrend100+Butterworth1; same40-180 prediction and reference
loss: direct negative Pearson + CE + KL, equal unit weights; integer classes40..179
literature_comparison: published reference, not matched reruns; exclude respiratory-rate tables
